annotation.title_clean: Proposte per una strategia italiana per l'intelligenza artificiale
annotation.title_en: Proposals for an Italian Strategy for Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministero dello Sviluppo Economico (MISE) – Gruppo di Esperti sull'intelligenza artificiale
named_instruments_referenced: EU Ethics Guidelines for Trustworthy AI
annotation.summary_en: Proposals from the Italian Ministry of Economic Development's (MISE) AI expert group for a national AI strategy (July 2019). They take a human-centred, sustainability-focused "RenAIssance" approach covering education, law, labour, trustworthy AI, the public sector, the data economy and embedded AI for industry. They also propose an inter-ministerial steering body ("cabina di regia") and a national AI institute.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes an inter-ministerial steering body ('cabina di regia') to govern the AI strategy, link it to better regulation and run horizon scanning
Recommends regulatory sandboxes and experimental pacts to test regulatory changes
Promotes embedded AI to strengthen Italian manufacturing and industry
Frames AI around sustainable development and social inclusion, in line with the EU vision of trustworthy AI
Proposes a national AI institute with a technology transfer arm and dedicated funding
